blocks.text: Voice talent and content creator Inka Magnaye expressed dismay as she shared that her mother, fellow voice talent Lindy Pellicer, lost a voice-over gig after the client opted to use artificial intelligence (AI) instead. “I just lost a voice over job to AI,” Pellicer told her family, as seen in the screenshot of her message shared by Magnaye on her Facebook page on Thursday, Oct. 8. Magnaye’s brother, Renzo, comforted their mom, saying it might be “a budget thing.” In the caption, Magnaye wrote, “My heart breaks for all the artists and creatives.” Without naming the brand involved in the project, […]...
